name: project-architect
description: Use when you want to design and bootstrap a new software project end-to-end inside Claude Code — or resume, upgrade, or re-architect one the architect previously produced. It interviews you across 12 phases (architecture is decided before the tech stack), files an ADR per decision, generates design docs + a root/per-folder CLAUDE.md + a stack-aware .claude/ tooling tree + plan docs, and gates the result with a 36-check, 4-tier mechanical auditor before lock — including enforcement that every generated config rides research-resolved newest-stable version pins, never a stale fallback. State is event-sourced through one architect-brain binary (replay-verified, schema 4.0); document selection is a declarative 107-document catalog; Golden Paths pre-fill 9 common stacks; a read-only Preflight router resumes / migrates / upgrades / re-architects a prior project. Supports 19+ project types — from web / mobile / API / CLI / library to MCP servers, agentic systems, and programming-language design.
